Name: Org username
Used in: Authorize an org; CLI commands (--target-org); Import and Export Products with CLI; OCI Postman environment
Sourced from: The Verify Your Account email. It looks like an email address, but it is a username.

Name: Org alias
Used in: CLI commands and deploys in VS Code; Create Products with Apex; Import Orders
Sourced from: The alias you chose in SFDX: Authorize an Org.

Name: Org Id
Used in: Create an Environment (trial extension request); OCI
Sourced from: Setup, Company Information. You can also find it in the output of sf org display.

Name: Org My Domain URL
Used in: Query with REST API; Composite API; Connect REST API; OCI Postman environment
Sourced from: Instance Url in the output of sf org display, or the address bar after you log in.

Name: Org login URL
Used in: Authorize an org; OCI Postman environment
Sourced from: Fixed value. Trial orgs use the production login URL.

Name: REST API version
Used in: Every REST API URL; Composite and Graph API activities; U0 Appendix J
Sourced from: REST API Developer Guide, Versions page (Winter '27 is API version 68.0).

Name: Trialforce Template Id
Used in: Create an Environment
Sourced from: The Order Management Environment Guide.

Name: Sales Channel Id
Used in: Place a Test Order; Place Additional Order; Import Historical Orders; Composite and Graph API activities; U0 Appendix J
Sourced from: SOQL on SalesChannel (U0 Appendix J, Option C, script 1).

Name: Standard Price Book Id
Used in: Place a Test Order; Place Additional Order; Composite and Graph API activities
Sourced from: SELECT Id FROM Pricebook2 WHERE Name = 'Standard Price Book'

Name: Shipping product Id
Used in: Configure Delivery Methods; Place a Test Order; Graph API activity
Sourced from: SOQL on Product2 (U0 Appendix J, Option C, script 5).

Name: Shipping price book entry Id
Used in: Place a Test Order; Place Additional Order; Graph API activity
Sourced from: SOQL on PricebookEntry (U0 Appendix J, Option C, script 3).

Name: Delivery method Id
Used in: Configure Delivery Methods; Place a Test Order; Graph API activity
Sourced from: SOQL on OrderDeliveryMethod (U0 Appendix J, Option C, script 4).

Name: Account Id
Used in: Place a Test Order; Composite and Graph API activities
Sourced from: SELECT Id, Name FROM Account

Name: Location Id
Used in: Fulfillment flow activities; Activate Omnichannel Inventory; OCI headless APIs
Sourced from: SOQL on Location, or the Locations tab.

Name: Location Group Id
Used in: Fulfillment flow activities; Activate Omnichannel Inventory
Sourced from: SOQL on LocationGroup, or the Location Groups tab.

Name: Order reference number
Used in: Place a Test Order; Place Additional Order; Composite and Graph API activities; U0 Appendix J
Sourced from: The order JSON payload. It must be unique for every run.

Name: Order number
Used in: Approve the Order Summary; Place Additional Order; U0 Appendices J and K
Sourced from: The Order record, or the response of the Composite API call.

Name: Order Summary Id
Used in: Approve, Allocate, Invoice, Fulfill, Discount and Return activities; Query with SOQL, REST API and Composite API
Sourced from: SELECT Id, OrderNumber FROM OrderSummary ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC LIMIT 5

Name: Order Item Summary Id
Used in: Discount an Order Item; Return the Order; Connect REST API basics
Sourced from: SELECT Id, Name FROM OrderItemSummary WHERE OrderSummaryId = '{OM_orderSummaryId}'

Name: Fulfillment Order Id
Used in: Generate the Invoice and Settle; Fulfill the Order; Create a Flow Action
Sourced from: SELECT Id, Status FROM FulfillmentOrder

Name: Invoice Id
Used in: Generate the Invoice and Settle
Sourced from: SELECT Id FROM Invoice, after you generate the invoice.

Name: Payment Gateway Provider Id
Used in: Create the Payment Gateway Provider; Create the Payment Gateway
Sourced from: The response of the composite request in the activity.

Name: Payment Gateway Id
Used in: Create the Payment Gateway; Capture Payment Token
Sourced from: The response of the composite request in the activity.

Name: Named Credential Id
Used in: Deploy Named Credentials; Create the Payment Gateway
Sourced from: The response of the composite request in the activity.

Name: OCI base URL
Used in: OCI headless APIs
Sourced from: Setup, Omnichannel Inventory, Base URL for Inventory API Calls.

Name: OCI tenant group Id
Used in: OCI headless APIs
Sourced from: Setup, Omnichannel Inventory, Tenant Group ID.

Name: OCI app consumer key
Used in: OCI headless APIs; JWT builder
Sourced from: Setup, App Manager, the app, Manage Consumer Details.

Name: OCI app consumer secret (Secret)
Used in: OCI headless APIs
Sourced from: Same page as the consumer key. Keep it private.

Name: OCI JWT token
Used in: OCI headless APIs
Sourced from: The JWT builder output. It expires after 1 hour.

Name: Security token (Secret)
Used in: OCI headless APIs
Sourced from: User settings, Reset My Security Token. Keep it private.

Name: Private key file path
Used in: OCI headless APIs; JWT builder
Sourced from: The folder where you saved your private key. Keep the file private.
